title: Tracy keeps working when the Joomla Claude Cowork release stops carrying contract profiles: the import puts the site's profile into the component from its release asset, and STAB-1 reads the index
expect: S1: every named test reports ok; for a slim package (administrator/lib/contracts.json, no contract folder) the picked profile and the one it names are put into packages/com_claudecowork.zip under administrator/lib/contracts/<id>/ and the result reads back under Python zipfile and PHP ZipArchive; an asset whose sha256 or length differs from the index is dropped; an unreachable asset leaves the package as released and the install still ends ok; STAB-1 says carries for an indexed id and lacks for an absent one; pin-joomla-cowork checks a slim release's profiles from their assets and refuses a mismatch

selectors.host: tracy-add-site joomla.ts installCowork contractsToKeep, slim-package.ts contractIndex indexedCandidates fetchContractAssets contractCandidates packageForImport

fence: A Joomla import never leaves a quickstart site without its contract because the release stopped packing profiles, and never puts an asset that does not match the release's index into a customer's site

tests: a slim release: the version the site serves is fetched, checked and put in, with the one it names
a slim package with a contract put in unpacks under PHP ZipArchive, as Joomla installs it
a slim release: an asset whose sha256 or length does not match the index is dropped
a slim release: an asset that cannot be fetched leaves the package as released
a slim release: the contract the site serves is fetched beside the package and put in
a slim release whose asset cannot be fetched still installs, the package as released
STAB-1: a slim Joomla package carries the contracts its index lists, with no contract folder
STAB-1: a Joomla package carries the contract inside its component zip
a slim release: each recorded profile is checked from its own asset, then the pins move
a slim release whose asset is not what its index says, or lists no recorded profile, is refused
a quickstart site keeps the one contract its served files match, under a 2 MB limit
a slim index id or asset name that is not plain is ignored; an asset with a path in an entry is dropped
